description_en: Moves database instances to a different project in batches
description_zh: 批量修改数据库实例所属项目
name: ModifyDatabasesProject

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to which the database instances currently belong
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例当前所属项目ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target project to which you want to move the database instances.
You can call the ListProjectsForProjectAuthorizationPrincipal operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移动到的目标所属项目 ID。
您可以调用ListProjectsForProjectAuthorizationPrincipal接口获取该参数
parameters.name: target_project_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the database instances that you want to move. This parameter is a JSON-formatted string. You can specify up to 100 database instance IDs. Separate multiple database instance IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要移动的数据库实例ID。该参数为 JSON 格式的字符串，最多可输入 100 个数据库实例 ID。多个数据库实例 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_ids
